messages:
Maya: Heads up, seeing ~12 GPU nodes in us-west2 go NotReady/NoSchedule since 05:10 UTC.
Raj: on it. any errors in kubelet or device-plugin logs?
Maya: kubelet shows kernel oops SIGBUS in dmesg on multiple nodes. device-plugin keeps crashloop with "failed to open /dev/nvidiactl".
Tom (SRE): hmm, SIGBUS usually hardware or driver mismatch after kernel update. Did we push a kernel or image update to that node pool?
Maya: We rolled image v1.4.2 last night (auto-rollout). Same node pool that runs spot GPUs.
Jen: cluster-autoscaler is also weird — can't drain nodes because of pods with local storage (ml-checkpoints PVCs) and pod disruption budgets.
Maya: pasted kubectl describe output:
```
Name: ip-10-0-1-7
Conditions:
  Ready: False (Kernel panic: SIGBUS)
Allocated resources: nvidia.com/gpu: 4
Events: device-plugin failed to register: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = could not open /dev/nvidiactl
```
Raj: can we cordon + taint to stop new pods, then reimage one node manually to validate image? If reimage fixes SIGBUS we roll back image or pin.
Tom (SRE): Doing that now. cordon + drain blocked due to checkpoint PV; will attempt scale down with --ignore-daemonsets and delete-local-data=... but need approval.
Jen: Approve delete-local-data for this pool? Those checkpoints are recoverable from S3 but take time.
Maya: :thumbsup: go ahead, prefer minimal downtime.
deploy-bot: Autoscaler event: NodePool/gpu-us-west2 failed to scale up due to quota: GPU quota exceeded. (automated)
Raj: that quota msg means we can't provision replacement nodes. We may need to shift workload to dedicated pool in us-west1 or request quota increase.
Tom (SRE): short term: taint nodes to NoSchedule, mark as NoExecute to remove running pods that block scale-down.
Maya: Also noticed device-plugin version is v0.11.0 while kernel module requires v525. Might be mismatched NV driver package in image.
Raj: plan: (1) cordon affected nodes, (2) reimage 1 node with older image v1.4.1 to validate, (3) if good rollback pool rollout and open ticket with cloud for quota bump and reserve a small dedicated pool for critical runs.
Jen: cost note — moving to dedicated reduces spot savings but avoids churn. recommend reserve 2 nodes as committed baseline to keep autoscaler healthy.
Tom (SRE): I've reimaged ip-10-0-1-7, kernel no SIGBUS now, device-plugin registers. Marking as Ready.
Maya: Nice. rolling pool rollback to v1.4.1 and create ticket to pin driver/kernel pairing in next release checklist.
Raj: adding a new healthcheck script to preflight nodes: verify /dev/nvidia* exists and run nvidia-smi — will add to node-init.
Maya: thanks. follow-up: create runbook for this failure mode and add canary gating to image rollout.
Jen: noted — I'll budget for 2 reserved gpus in us-west2 for Q2, will record cost impact.
Tom (SRE): closing loop: reimage fixed, autoscaler freed after cordon, created internal ticket INF-4321.
Maya: Thanks all, will monitor next 2 hours. :eyes:
